description: Implement clipboard paste functionality that regenerates block IDs when pasting between documents to prevent duplicate ID errors in Postgres/SQLite databases. The system should preserve all other block data while ensuring newly pasted blocks have unique IDs that comply with database constraints.
functional_requirements: When pasting clipboard data containing blocks, regenerate fresh ObjectIDs for all fields ending with '.id' to ensure global uniqueness
Maintain a mapping between original clipboard IDs and newly generated IDs to update parent field metadata (rows arrays) that reference these IDs
Handle both top-level blocks and nested block structures (e.g., layout.subBlocks) during the ID regeneration process
Preserve all non-ID field data from the original clipboard content during the paste operation
Support paste operations across different documents while maintaining data integrity and database compatibility
